current_noise.hf_behavior: plotted only to ~30 MHz. Cancellation disabled: falls to ~2.2 pA/rtHz at 10 MHz, then rises mildly to ~3.2 pA/rtHz at 30 MHz (end of plot). Not specified above 30 MHz.
current_noise.how_measured_or_defined: spot values TYP at 1 MHz; G13 not stated as measured or simulated. Curve identity fixed by the table values (higher curve = cancellation enabled); the in-plot labels are ambiguous. No explanation of the upturn above 10 MHz. Text p18/p20: lower eN is bought with higher collector current, raising iN; enabling bias cancellation increases current noise; iN dominates when R_EQ > 1.8 kOhm (cancellation disabled).

pinout_notes: SHDN referenced to V+: < V+ - 2.75 V shuts down (outputs high-impedance, ~500 uA); within 350 mV of V+ enables input-bias cancellation; floating = on, cancellation off (internally biased 1.2 V below V+). Bypass with 0.1 uF || 1000 pF; no ground/supply plane under the input pins.

tia_content.what: High-speed high-dynamic-range photodiode amplifier: JFET (ON Semi 2SK932-22) source-follower front end inside the LTC6228 loop
tia_content.C_D_or_source_C: photodiode SFH213 (capacitance not given), anode at -5 V
tia_content.bandwidth: -3 dB 4.6 MHz; rise time 77 ns; integrated output noise 661 uV rms over 4.6 MHz; output noise density ~150 nV/rtHz at 100 kHz rising to ~410 nV/rtHz near 5 MHz

tia_content.what: Gain-stage noise model: eT^2 = en^2 + in^2 R_EQ^2 + 4kT R_EQ, R_EQ = R_S1 + R_G || R_F; voltage noise dominates for R_EQ << 47 Ohm, resistor noise for 55 Ohm << R_EQ << 1.8 kOhm, current noise above 1.8 kOhm (cancellation disabled)
Feedback-pole guidance: 1 kOhm/1 kOhm G = +2 with 7 pF at -IN oscillates (pole 45 MHz), 7 pF across RF fixes it; a 5 kOhm feedback resistor with 400 fF parasitic affects gain above 79 MHz

application_guidance: Front page lists 'Optical electronics: fast transimpedance amplifiers'. Capacitive loads: 10-100 Ohm series output resistor (G35/G36 overshoot vs CL). Use 0306 rather than 0603 capacitors for low inductance. For SOIC take feedback from the FB pin. No resistor in series with the inputs internally (noise); limit differential input current.
abs_max_and_input_protection: Total supply 12 V; inputs and SHDN V- - 0.3 V to V+ + 0.3 V; input current +/-10 mA; output +/-100 mA; junction 150 C; storage -65 to 150 C. Back-to-back diodes D5/D7 limit the differential input to +/-0.7 V; limit current to < 10 mA (about 25 Ohm per 250 mV of overdrive beyond 0.7 V). Not for comparator/open-loop use. Avoid hot-plugging (supply clamp).
other_notes: Front-page GBW 890 MHz is at f = 5 MHz; the open-loop gain falls faster above ~50 MHz, so the open-loop 0 dB crossing is only ~295 MHz while the AV = 1 closed-loop -3 dB is 730 MHz (with ~1.9 dB peaking). G13 in-plot labels for the two current-noise curves are ambiguous; the table values identify them. VOH 5 mA row says 'ISINK'. Pages 22-23 (instrumentation amp, differential-to-single-ended converter) read from text only.
pages_read: PDF pages 1-21 and 30 rendered at 120 dpi and read; pages 22-23 (non-TIA application circuits), 24-28 (package drawings) and 29 (revision history) read from extracted text only. Curves G13, G26, G27, G28, G29, G31 read from PDF vector paths. PDF page index = printed page number.
